entity.summary: Self-custody hardware-wallet ecosystem from CoolBitX/CoolWallet, centered on card-form hardware devices and a companion application.
entity.notes: Current first-party storefront states that CoolWallet has been devoted to the wallet business since 2014.

products.summary: Premium credit-card-sized CoolWallet hardware wallet for offline key protection and companion-app use.
products.notes: Current first-party storefront lists CoolWallet Pro as an active purchasable hardware wallet. Exact initial launch date remains unresolved.

events.title: CoolWallet Pro released
events.description: CoolBitX announced the release of CoolWallet Pro on 2021-05-20, with the device available to order and order fulfillment stated to begin from 2021-05-24.
events.notes: Release announcement date retained; later fulfillment start not backdated.

evidence.title: CoolWallet — Simplify and Secure Your Crypto Journey
evidence.notes: Current first-party storefront states 'Since 2014' and identifies CoolWallet's continuing wallet business.

evidence.title: CoolWallet Hardware Wallets
evidence.notes: Current first-party storefront identifies CoolWallet Pro as the advanced hardware model and the CoolWallet App as decentralized and self-custodial.

evidence.title: Introducing the CoolWallet Pro For Enhanced Staking, DeFi, DApp, and NFT Support
